CLAIM 0.031250","counterconditions":[{"case":"If (1/4,0),(0,1/4),(1/2,1/2) are actually collinear, minimum is 0","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If any boundary triple has area less than 1/32","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the center point creates a smaller triangle with boundary points","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"12 boundary points at quarter positions (4 corners + 2 points per side at 1/4 and 3/4) plus center (0.5,0.5). The minimum triangle area comes from the smallest triangle. Triple (0,0),(1/4,0),(0,1/4): area = 0.5*(1/4)*(1/4) = 1/32 = 0.03125. Triple (1/4,0),(1/2,1/2),(3/4,0): area = 0.5*(1/2)*(1/2) = 1/8. Triple (0,0),(1/4,0),(1/2,1/2): area = 0.5*|(1/4)(1/2)| = 1/16. Triple (1/4,0),(0,1/4),(1/2,1/2): area = 0.5*|(-1/4)(1/2) - (1/2)(-1/4)| = 0.5*|-1/8 + 1/8| = 0. This is collinear! (1/4,0),(0,1/4),(1/2,1/2) are on line x+y=1/4... no: 1/4+0=1/4, 0+1/4=1/4, 1/2+1/2=1. Not collinear. Let me recompute: area = 0.5*|(0-1/4)(1/2-0) - (1/2-1/4)(1/4-0)| = 0.5*|(-1/4)(1/2) - (1/4)(1/4)| = 0.5*|-1/8 - 1/16| = 0.5*3/16 = 3/32. Triple (1/4,0),(3/4,0),(1/2,1/2): area = 0.5*|(1/2)(1/2) - (1/4)(0)| = 1/8. Triple (0,1/4),(1/4,0),(1/2,1/2): area = 3/32 as computed. So minimum is 1/32 from corner triples.
